items.text: Hello everyone,
The patch #4 (1.2.06) is here!
TAA anti-aliasing is now enabled by default
Several visual polishes throughout the game (improved lighting and materials)
During the wolf pursuit sequence, fixed the wolf's idle animation that was breaking when the boy pushed the barrel
Fixed an issue where the boy could get stuck inside the first bramble elevator
Fixed the deer sometimes getting stuck in front of the door opened by the Darkboy in the Mines
To help us investigate and fix bugs, please include as much information as possible in your report :)
A video of the issue whenever possible.
A screenshot if you can't record a video.
Your log files.
A short description of what happened and how the issue occurred.
Videos are especially helpful as they allow us to see exactly what happened and make reproducing the issue much easier! :)
You can find the game's log files here: %UserProfile%\\AppData\\LocalLow\\LIFELINE\\DeerAndBoy
Other interesting info could include PC specs (CPU, GPU, ram, monitor resolution etc.) The more information you provide, the easier it is for us to track down and fix the issue!
Hello everyone,
The patch #3 (1.2.03) is here!
Various animations polished in cutscenes transitions
Turnback animation in mud or puddle is now a little faster
Drop and Pick deer in bag is now more permissive (near walls or obstacles)
HelpToJump feature in Chapter 10 now only needs 1 input instead of 2
A Call animation has been added whenever cuddle is not possible
Using the Cuddle input will now work as a Call if the deer needs to go through a path or opening to join the Boy
Fixed showDeer cursor sometimes going in wrong position on non-1080 monitors
Freeze frame issue from option menu fixed

Hello everyone,
The big update is here! Thanks to your feedback and cooperation, we were able to identify issues such as the boy spinning in circles, the cursor not pointing to objects, and many others :)
Please feel free to share your feedback in the comments or reviews!
Added input prompts for 2 features introduced in chapter 10
Fixed issue with the cursor failing to aim interactive objects using the Show feature on specific 1366x768 monitors

Hello everyone,
We hope you're having a good time playing our demo!
Some of you have reported that the deer wouldn't go through the opening in the fence during the first puzzle... So we've released a hotfix to fix this issue:
Fixed an issue in which the deer would not go through the opening in the fence.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41436360/e10ccbc623b5d075dd6307cf6d4f0727d2a08b07.png"]Good job! You and the Deer are reunited again :D
If you encounter any other bugs, feel free to check out the Bug Report section of the Community Hub you might already find an answer to your question there, or we'll get back to you :)
And if you play, we'd love to hear what you think. Leaving a review on the demo and dropping your feedback genuinely helps a small team like ours shape the final game!
